summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's preinstall lifecycle hook runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime binary from GitHub (oven-sh/bun releases, pinned v1.3.13) and uses it to execute a bundled sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB Bun-compiled JavaScript blob (`// @bun @bun-cjs`) with string-array-shuffle obfuscation (rotator function iterating over an array and pushing/shifting entries) and hex-mangled identifiers, executed on the installer's machine at install time. setup.mjs itself is obfuscated in the same style (hex-mangled identifiers `_0x488df8`/`_0x52943e` wrapping fs/https imports, per-function property maps). Using an alternate runtime (Bun) to execute the payload evades Node-level static analysis; the payload is not human-auditable, so any install-time behavior (credential theft, persistence, backdoor, exfiltration) is possible. The stated purpose of the package (`condition-builder` UI helper) has no legitimate need for a downloaded Bun runtime at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
